note: In the main shape '#%', n1 equals the tagged interest_rate in 6561 of 6561 rows, and the tag sits in this cell, so the column is the all-in rate. In '#% (incl #% PIK)', n1 is the total (all-in) and n2 matches the tagged pik_rate (3 of 3). A bare '#% PIK' cell matches the pik_rate tag (63 of 63), so it is a fixed PIK rate.
